priorityList: Apply poisons and enter Stealth before combat.
Use Shadow Blades when Shadow Dance and Secret Technique are ready or the fight is about to end.
Use Shadow Dance if you are out of Stealth, have low Combo Points, and Secret Technique is ready or Shadow Blades is active.
Use Vanish or Shadowmeld at low Combo Points to trigger Stealth benefits and generate resources.
Sync offensive trinkets, potions, and racial abilities with your Shadow Blades window.
Cast Secret Technique as your top priority finisher if Shadow Dance is active or if its cooldown is high.
Use Coup de Grace as a finisher if Secret Technique is on cooldown or Shadow Dance is active.
Use Black Powder as a finisher if there are 3 or more targets (or 2 or more with the Potent Powder talent).
Use Eviscerate as a finisher for low target counts or if other priority spenders are unavailable.
Use Shuriken Storm as your primary builder whenever there are 2 or more targets.
Use Goremaw's Bite as a builder if you have a deficit of 3 or more Combo Points.
Use Shadowstrike as a builder during Stealth or Shadow Dance if Unseen Blade is active or for priority damage on fewer than 4 targets.
Use Gloomblade or Backstab as a builder only if Shuriken Storm is not applicable.
Ensure you are at or near maximum Combo Points before using any finishing move.
Use Arcane Torrent if your energy is low to maintain rotational flow.
